title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Cats Are the Best Superdrop

paragraphs.text: Cats Are the Best is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on June 15, 2026.

In March 2025, Secret Lair Drop Series: Cats vs. Dogs was released in the Chaos Vault . Each of the two drops consisted of the same five reprints, but themed after their respective animal ( cats and dogs ). In addition to the sale of the drops, Wizards of the Coast ran a competition to see which animal would receive a full superdrop themed around that creature type in 2026 . The choice was determined by the drop that sold best.

Within three hours, the foil cat drop was the first to sell out, and within six hours, Cats were declared to be the winner of the competition. This is their Superdrop. The drops depict cats from several franchises, and by artists who use cats as a returning motive in their work.
Buyers receive a foil Garfield Lasagna Food promo token with art by Gaboleps for each $199 spent while supplies last.
Customers are able to purchase one of three bundles :
Nine Lives Non-Foil Bundle —One copy of each drop in non-foil for $224.99.
Laser Focus Foil Bundle —One copy of each drop in traditional foil for $299.99.
Cats Rule Everything Bundle —One copy of each drop in non-foil and one copy of each drop in foil for $519.99.

As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card . For some drops, the exact card issued is random and could include retro frame humans (e.g. Glowrider or Knight of the White Orchid ), Serra Ascendant or General's Enforcer . The fixed bonus cards for the other drops are listed below.
